add_roles.reason: Core quant-finance role explicitly missing; buy-side/hedge-fund alpha research is central to the domain.
Core quant-finance engineering role explicitly missing; builds pricing/execution/backtesting infrastructure.
The archetypal 'quant' (pricing/risk quant) is absent though the domain is named Quantitative Finance.
Quantitative risk management is a pillar of quant finance and no risk role is present.

reviews.notes: Domain is heavily miscomposed: ~13 pure accounting/audit/tax roles (ISCO 2411) belong in Accounting (D015), not Quantitative Finance. Large over-fanout of near-duplicate trader/broker/dealer roles (10+ ISCO 3311 sales agents) dilutes the quant-finance signal. The genuinely quantitative core (mathematician 2120, statistician 2120, securities/financial/investment analyst 2413) is thin and the four true quant roles were missing/added. 'Credit Analysts' has NaN aka and odd capitalization/pluralization (data hygiene).

add_roles.reason: FinTech runs on real-time transaction/market data pipelines; no data engineering role is present.
Blockchain/crypto engineering is a defining FinTech engineering specialism and is absent.
Payments/banking APIs and microservices are the backbone of FinTech engineering; only generic software developer/analyst present.
Regulated, high-availability FinTech systems require dedicated DevOps/SRE; missing from the engineering domain.

reviews.notes: Domain name says 'FinTech Engineering' but ~28 of 36 roles are finance sales/broker/credit/lending roles (ISCO 3311/3312), not engineering. Only software analyst, software developer, and four QA/test roles are genuinely engineering, and the four test roles are near-duplicate over-fanout of one ICT-testing concept. Core FinTech engineering roles (data/backend/blockchain/DevOps) were missing and added. Two junk rows: 'FinTech Engineers' and 'Securities, Commodities, and Financial Services Sales Agents' have NaN aka and are ISCO group labels, not roles (data hygiene).

add_roles.reason: The definitive investment-analysis role (sell-side/buy-side equity research) is absent though it is the domain's namesake activity.
Investment analysis feeds portfolio management; a distinct PM role is missing amid many advisory roles.
Fixed-income/credit analysis is a core pillar of investment analysis and no dedicated credit-analysis role is present.

reviews.notes: 57 roles is bloated and mixed. A strong, correct investment-advisory core exists (ISCO 2412: investment manager/adviser, corporate investment banker, venture capitalist, fund manager, risk managers). But the domain is polluted by (a) 7 insurance/property/gemstone appraisal & claims roles (ISCO 3315) that belong to Insurance/Valuation, (b) ~13 accounting/audit/tax roles (ISCO 2411) that belong to Accounting, and (c) heavy over-fanout of near-duplicate trader/broker/sales-agent roles (ISCO 3311). Analysis-side roles (equity research, credit, portfolio management) were thin and added. 'Financial and Investment Advisers' is a junk ISCO-group row with NaN aka (data hygiene).

add_roles.reason: The domain is named Actuarial Science yet the qualified actuary role only appears as a junk ISCO-group row ('Actuaries', NaN aka); a proper role is needed.
Pricing is a primary actuarial specialism (general insurance/life) and is absent as a distinct role.
Actuarial work centres on quantitative risk/capital; only a junk 'Risk Management Specialists' group row exists, no real risk role.
Modern actuarial/insurance analytics increasingly overlaps data science; a quantitative modelling role complements the thin core.

reviews.notes: Actuarial core is very thin and largely unqualified: only actuarial consultant, actuarial assistant, mathematician and statistician are on-target; the actual 'Actuaries' entry is a junk ISCO-group row with NaN aka. The domain is dominated by off-topic clusters: ~7 generic business/management consulting roles (ISCO 2421: business analyst, lean manager, BIM consultant, logistics analyst, etc.), ~7 insurance underwriting/broking/claims roles (ISCO 3315/3321) that belong to an Insurance domain, and property/gemstone appraisers. Several junk group-label rows with NaN aka ('Risk Management Specialists','Actuaries','Insurance Sales Agents') need data hygiene. True actuarial roles (actuary, pricing actuary, quantitative risk) were added.

add_roles.reason: Management/cost accounting is a core branch of accounting distinct from financial accounting/audit and is not represented as a role.
Payroll is a standard accounting-clerk function (ISCO 4313) and is missing from an otherwise clerk-heavy domain.

reviews.notes: Most coherent domain in the batch: the professional accounting/audit core (ISCO 2411 accountant, financial auditor, audit supervisor, tax advisor, controller, cost analyst, etc.) and clerk tier (ISCO 3313/4311/4312 bookkeeper, accounting assistant, billing/tax/auditing clerks) are correctly placed. Main problems are data hygiene: 5 junk ISCO-group-label rows with NaN aka ('Accountants and Auditors','Bookkeeping, Accounting, and Auditing Clerks','Bill and Account Collectors','Billing and Posting Clerks','Procurement Clerks') duplicate existing real roles and should be removed. A few peripheral non-accounting clerks (insurance clerk, property/real-estate assistant, forex cashier, sales support) belong to other domains. Management accountant and payroll clerk added to round out the core.
